violation_type.title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §744.605(15))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan
violation_type.typical_finding: Two children with allergies had incomplete FARE forms as they were missing one medication listed for each child by the physician.

finding_variants.text: Two children with allergies had incomplete FARE forms as they were missing one medication listed for each child by the physician.

The operation has one child enrolled with a food allergy and no food allergy plan in their file.
The operation has one child enrolled and does not have a food allergy plan in their file.
